item.name: Provides a list of basic vendor and product related information.

request.name: Provides a list of basic vendor and product related information.

description.content: Provides high level client configuration information including a list of the vendors and the vendor's products, a list of the profile fields for each vendor, a list of all active contracts and the products with which they are associated, a list of oversight requirements and a list of users.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
